description: Fixed contract for the write-capable Codex implementation runner. It is a SEPARATE component from the read-only review runner, which it does not modify and does not replace. Writes are contained by the operating system first and validated by the trusted coordinator second; a prompt is never a containment mechanism.

layers.mechanism: workspace-write sandbox rooted at the assigned worktree
protects: the real git directory, which for a linked worktree lives outside the worktree

layers.mechanism: read-only file attribute applied to protected in-repo paths for the duration of the run, restored afterwards
protects: the retired trading and execution subsystem
the guard hook and its settings
the coordination tooling itself unless explicitly assigned

layers.mechanism: post-run diff confined to the assigned task paths; an out-of-scope change is a failure and is reverted, never committed
protects: task-path boundaries inside the assigned worktree
layers.note: This layer alone is NOT containment. It bounds task paths within a tree the operating system has already contained.

accounting.record: every spent attempt records exactly one terminal outcome
accounting.duplicate_execution: a task with a recorded outcome is never re-run

non_authorization_sentence: This implementation grants no permission to modify, commit, push, merge, deploy, trade, alter risk, or enable execution.
